provenance: Committed deterministic regression corpus (W3 multilingual round). Recreates the independently-reported multilingual fixture — Python, Go, Java properties, Terraform, Docker, GitHub Actions, Firebase rules, dependency manifests — with the REPORTED source patterns preserved (values are generated by setup.mjs as fixed literals, so the public repo contains no fake-but-plausible credentials and the tree is byte-deterministic). Expectations below were recorded from the REAL CLI scan of the generated tree, never from rule names. This is a self-curated boundary corpus: it documents BOTH what fires and what is deliberately out of scope.
matching_rules: An expected detection is confirmed only when a finding has exactly the manifest rule id, the manifest file, and the exact absolute line, with severity at or above severity_floor.
Safe files expect ZERO findings above LOW severity (LOW/info review notes are advisory and scoreless).
Out-of-scope files expect ZERO findings at any severity — the boundary is LOCKED silent so a future rule that starts firing there cannot do so unnoticed.
The total finding count is asserted exactly (the engine must produce no unexpected extras on this corpus).
